ideas.pitch: A multilingual local health assistant tailored for rural communities to provide preventive care, vaccine tracking, and symptom guidance over basic telephony and low-bandwidth web interfaces.
ideas.problem_statement: Rural Development: Solutions for agriculture, rural livelihoods, digital/financial inclusion, and rural healthcare access.
ideas.title: ArogyaVani
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly mirrors the exact architecture and social impact patterns of SAGACITY which won first prize by focusing on rural healthcare awareness and localized language support.

ideas.pitch: An AI-powered smartphone assistant designed for elderly users featuring large typography, contextual voice navigation, and simplified accessibility support to combat social isolation.
ideas.problem_statement: Mental Wellbeing & Community Care: Solutions for mental health support, elderly care, accessibility, and stronger, more resilient communities.
ideas.title: Sahayak Senior
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages the winning blueprint of GrandmaHelper by focusing explicitly on demographic accessibility, addressing a felt need for elder-friendly digital infrastructure.

ideas.pitch: A real-time emergency resource and responder routing platform that aggregates community alerts and dispatches rapid response squads during natural or civic crises.
ideas.problem_statement: Energy & Sustainability: Ideas around renewable energy, waste management, water conservation, and cleaner cities.
ideas.title: CrisisRoute
ideas.why_it_could_win: Adopts the proven architecture of Oarfin and HERO, emphasizing live working demonstrations, spatial mapping, and undeniable emergency utility.

ideas.pitch: A community-driven safety and resource navigation platform for women and children that routes users away from high-risk zones using calibrated crowd-sourced confidence scores.
ideas.problem_statement: Women & Child Empowerment: Tools for safety, education, financial independence, and better maternal & child health.
ideas.title: Suraksha
ideas.why_it_could_win: Combines the honest AI routing and calibrated confidence pipelines seen in Clearpath AI with a high-impact local safety focus that resonates heavily with judges.

ideas.pitch: A hyper-local waste management and recycling tracking platform that rewards citizens for proper segregation while offering municipal dashboards for optimal collection schedules.
ideas.problem_statement: Energy & Sustainability: Ideas around renewable energy, waste management, water conservation, and cleaner cities.
ideas.title: EcoCycle Hub
ideas.why_it_could_win: Employs the walk-to-earn and live dashboard strategy proven by catwalk, turning municipal waste tracking into an engaging, gamified civic experience.
